phases.name: Phase 01: Analysis
tasks: Audit existing project files and database schema requirement
Define models for services, products, projects, components, enquiries
Establish API contract between Django DRF and React Frontend

phases.name: Phase 02: Scaffolding & Docker
tasks: Configure requirements.txt / dependencies (Django, djangorestframework, django-cors-headers)
Create Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for backend
Configure CORS settings and static/media configurations in settings.py

phases.name: Phase 03: Backend Models & Admin
tasks: Implement Service model in services/models.py
Implement Product model in products/models.py
Implement Project and Component models in projects/models.py
Implement Enquiry models in home/models.py
Register all models in respective admin.py files with list_display, search_fields, list_filter
Generate and execute Django migrations

phases.name: Phase 04: DRF API & Throttling
tasks: Create serializers for all models in respective apps
Create DRF ViewSets / APIViews for services, products, projects, enquiries
Implement throttling for enquiry POST endpoints
Register API endpoints in laxmi/urls.py under /api/v1/

phases.name: Phase 05: Frontend Setup & Routing
tasks: Initialize React frontend with Vite in frontend/ directory
Setup Axios API client with base URL configuration
Setup React Router DOM for SPA navigation
Create responsive Navbar and Footer components with shop branding

phases.name: Phase 06: Frontend Pages & Forms
tasks: Build Home page with banner, featured items, service grid, location section
Build Services page with repair enquiry modal
Build Projects page with component store & custom project request form
Build Products page with category/condition filters & purchase modal
Build About Us & Contact pages with interactive submission

phases.name: Phase 07: SEO, Accessibility & Mobile
tasks: Add meta tags, page titles, and semantic HTML structure
Ensure full mobile responsiveness and touch accessibility
Add toast notifications for form submissions and loading spinners

phases.name: Phase 08: Docker Production, CI/CD & Audit
tasks: Create production Docker Compose setup with Nginx
Create GitHub Actions CI workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml
Verify backend API and frontend build execution
